set.body: Scope: PRD Phases 0-2. Freeze the foundational decisions, establish the neutral response-domain kernel with compatibility adapters, and split pure archive revisions from resource-backed payload execution. This epic preserves current selected-read behavior while creating the typed planning, ownership, domain-identity, resource, validation, and receipt seams needed by later representation work. Close only after its three contained slices pass their focused JVM and Scala.js gates and the current NeuroArchive-dataset bridge remains green.
set.title: EPIC RRA-A: response kernel and archive resource seams
